chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar al-Hafiz al-Baghdadi narrated to us in the City of Peace (Baghdad). He said: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ibn Zakariyya Abu Abdillah and al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Sukuni narrated to us. They said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Sukuni narrated to us. He said: Salih ibn Abi al-Aswad narrated to us from Abu al-Mutahhar al-Madhari, from Sallam al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him), from Abu Burza, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family),

He said: Surely, God — Mighty and Majestic — made a covenant with me regarding Ali. I said: 'O Lord, reveal it to me.' He said: 'Listen.' I said: 'I am listening.' He said: 'Surely, Ali is the Banner of Guidance, the Imam of My friends, the light of those who obey Me, and he is the word that I have bound upon the God-fearing. Whoever loves him loves Me, and whoever obeys him has obeyed Me.'

key_terms.الْكَلِمَةُ: The Word — used theologically to denote a divine decree or appointed reality
key_terms.الْمُتَّقِينَ: The God-fearing/pious — those who observe taqwa, the criterion for sincere allegiance
key_terms.رَايَةُ الْهُدَى: Banner of Guidance — a title signifying Ali's role as the standard-bearer and locus of divine direction
key_terms.عَهِدَ: Made a covenant/entrusted — signifies a divine promise or binding command

ai.seo_question: What covenant did God make with the Prophet Muhammad regarding Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a divine covenant communicated to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) regarding the status of Imam Ali (AS). God declares Ali to be the Banner of Guidance and the Imam of His close friends, equating love and obedience to Ali with love and obedience to God Himself. The hadith was transmitted through Imam al-Baqir (AS) and the companion Abu Burza, reflecting the Shia theological emphasis on the divine appointment of the Imams and the metaphysical station of Ali as the criterion of guidance.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Umar al-Hafith al-Baghdadi narrated to us in the City of Peace (Baghdad). He said: Muhammad b. al-Qasim b. Zakariyya Abu `Abdillah and al-Husayn b. `Ali al-Sukuni narrated to us. They said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Sukuni narrated to us. He said: Salih b. Abi'l Aswad narrated to us from Abi'l Mathar al-Mudhari from Salam al-Ju`fi from Abi Ja`far al-Baqir (as) from Abi Burza from the Prophet (s).

He said: Surely, Allah made a covenant to me regarding `Ali. I said: “O Lord! Reveal it to me.” He said: “Listen.” I said: “I am listening.” He said: “Surely, `Ali is the Banner of Guidance, the Imam of My friends, the light of those who obey Me, and the word that the Godfearing stick to. Whoever loves him has loved Me, and whoever obeys him has obeyed Me.”
